primary_scope: same 103 archived fixtures and identical two-way price snapshots; retrospective diagnostic only
market_reference: direction of production Shin market probabilities from identical stored odds
vote_reference: reconstructed source-author plurality, not late sources admitted into live policy
settlement: full-game two-way winner, draw refunds one unit
wallet_sensitivity_timing_assumption: all observed fixtures of a KST date settle together at date end; reserve simultaneous worst-case stake, do not use same-date winners to finance new bets
risk_curve: KST calendar-date aggregated P/L; not intraday drawdown or actual settlement-time wallet
promotion_conditions: independently audited true pregame common inputs, source lineage and sale prices; historical self-declared flags alone do not qualify
fixed candidate and two time-separated prospective evaluation windows; no result-based retuning or repeated unadjusted significance checks
M0 candidate: paired ROI advantage over operating vote and market; market candidate: advantage over vote, not itself; multiplicity-adjusted lower bounds above zero
paired accuracy lower bound at least zero versus operating vote
ROI advantage positive in each predeclared time window, with drawdown and lower-tail losses no worse than operating vote
same-stake monthly-loss-limited paper sensitivity does not worsen losses; unresolved exposure and real settlement clocks validated before reliance
tests and source/runtime verification pass; production release explicitly authorized
